text:
Predicates:
ArtificiallySelected(x) ::: x is artificially selected.
BreedBack(x, y) ::: x is bred back to resemble y.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x are Heck cattle.
Aurochs(y) ::: y are aurochs.
Resembles(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(y) ::: y is extinct.
Premises:
BreedBack(heckCattle, aurochs) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back to resemble aurochs.
HeckCattle(heckCattle) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are animals.
Resembles(x, y) :- (BreedBack(x, y) ∧ HeckCattle(x) ∧ Aurochs(y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificiallySelected(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
